hypothesis: In checker-lexical.ts ending(), tajweed nasal allophones (ikhfaa ں and iqlab/ikhfaa-shafawi ۾) are not in CONSONANTS, so pronouncing tanween/noon sakinah as plain ن (or meem sakinah as plain م) looks like adding a consonant suffix and triggers wrong_word (5 of 11 declared FPs and 5 of 13 free+leadin FPs on help eval). Treating ں->ن and ۾->ن/م as tajweed variants of the word's own forms eliminates those false warnings without losing recall.
author: Yazin
